'''Threna''' was a [[Supreme-Class Servant Droid|''Supreme''-Class Servant Droid]]. Accidentally shipped to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grathus]], she was taken by [[Xig Rollem]] to serve drinks at [[Xig Rollem's tavern|his tavern]].
